name: script_run
description: Execute a registered script immediately and return its output. Use this when the CEO agent needs to run an ad-hoc task: a crawler, a data transformer, a one-shot migration, a health check. The script is identified by `scriptCode` (e.g. 'z-biz-news-crawler', 'db-backup', 'reindex-knowledge'). Pass parameters as a JSON object — these become the script's CLI args or env vars. Returns the script output (stdout + stderr combined) and exit code. WARNING: scripts run in a sandbox with the executor's permissions — only run trusted scripts. For repeated/scheduled execution, use schedule_register with this scriptCode as the executorHandler.

scriptCode.description: Identifier of a registered script. List available via script_register (returns list of registered scripts) or GET /api/script/list.

parameters.description: Script-specific parameters as JSON. The script decides how to interpret. e.g. {"hours_back": 1, "channels": ["hn", "tc"]} for a news crawler.

timeout.description: Max execution time in seconds. Default 300 (5 min). 0 = no limit (use with caution).
